blocks.text: Naam hi se zahir hai ke diene woh molecule hai jis mein carbon atoms ke darmiyan do double bonds hon. Conjugated diene mein carbon chain ke double bonds ke beech aik single bond hota hai (C=C–C=C). Conjugated dienes ke paas paas wale double bonds teen ya zyada saath wale atoms ke p-orbitals ko overlap karne dete hain. Is overlap se electrons delocalize ho jate hain (aik jagah qaid rehne ki bajaye phail jate hain), jo molecule ko stable karta hai aur us ki reactivity par asar dalta hai. Conjugated dienes mein π bond ka overlap poore system par phaila hota hai.

blocks.alt: CH2=CH-CH=CH2, but-1,3-diene; CH2=C(CH3)-CH=CH2, CH3 doosre carbon ke oopar, 2-methylbut-1,3-diene (isoprene); aur C-C-C-C zanjeer jis ke har carbon par oopar neeche p orbital lobe, oopar neeche lehardar lakeeron se jure: 'Delocalization of pi electrons of the conjugated bonds'.
blocks.caption: Conjugated dienes aur pi electrons ki delocalisation (kitab ke safha 265 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chaaron carbons ke p orbitals saath saath khare hain, is liye π electrons sirf do carbons ke darmiyan nahi rehte balki poori chain par phail jate hain (delocalization). Lehrdaar lakeerein yahi phaila hua π badal dikhati hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki figure mein ‘pie electrons’ chhapa hai; sahi lafz ‘pi electrons’ hai.

Conjugated alkenes organic chemistry mein compounds ki aham class hain; double bonds ki khaas tarteeb ki wajah se in ki properties khaas hain. 1,3-butadiene jaise conjugated dienes synthetic rubber banane mein istemal hote hain. Conjugated structure polymerization ko mumkin banati hai, jis se lambi chains banti hain jo rubber jaisi hoti hain.

blocks.prompt: Buta-1,3-diene ki structure banayein, us ke electrons ki delocalization dikhayein, aur batayein ke conjugated alkenes alag double bonds wale alkenes se mukhtalif kyun react kar sakte hain (Quick Check 11.10; exercise Q.2h).
blocks.explanation: CH₂=CH–CH=CH₂: chaar sp² carbons aik plane mein, har aik par aik p orbital. Carbon 1 se 4 tak ke p orbitals sab parallel aur paas paas hain, is liye woh chain ke oopar neeche lagataar overlap karte hain aur chaar π electrons do bonds mein qaid rehne ki bajaye poore system par phail jate hain. Is delocalization se energy kam hoti hai, is liye diene do alag double bonds se zyada stable hai, aur electrophile siron par (1,4-addition) bhi jur sakta hai.

items: Conjugated diene: C=C–C=C, double bonds ke beech aik single bond; p orbitals teen ya zyada atoms par overlap kar ke π electrons delocalize karte hain, molecule stable hota hai; buta-1,3-diene se synthetic rubber banta hai.
